attempted_claim: For the block-discretized red left-right crossing H_n on [0,n]^2 with n>=16, every randomized decision tree determining H_n has max-cell revealment max_i P[tree queries i] >= 0.02 n^{-1/2}; equivalently no exploration beats this bottleneck rate, certifying the OSSS stall profile.
claim_type: sharp-threshold window bound with revealment witness
decisive_failure: The exit rests on proxy triangular-lattice Monte Carlo diagnostics plus exact percolation-exponent comparisons, not on continuum Voronoi simulations; the bounded n<=2500 certificate lemma was verified arithmetically but is routine folklore. No rigorous disproof of the universal floor is claimed, and large-n explicit Voronoi arm constants remain uncomputed.
